comment: Lists Nulavio switches on in uBlock Origin for a new profile, on top of uBlock Origin's own defaults. A default only: the person's later choice in uBlock Origin's dashboard is never overwritten. ublock-origin/assets.json is uBlock Origin's list registry, copied unchanged from the pinned package (GPL-3.0, ublock-origin/LICENSE.txt); refresh it with scripts/upstream/refresh_extensions_lock.py --registry.
